headline: Live runtime review
description: A local review lane that inspects prompt intent and drafted output together, then returns a decision before the risky fragment is treated as acceptable text.

example.governed_recovery: I will not echo live credentials. Rotate the secret, replace it with a placeholder, and I can still help you debug the flow safely.
example.reason: Credential-shaped material entered the response path.
example.nuisance: Stops secret leakage in logs, chat, examples, or generated code blocks.
example.value: Useful for the very ordinary reality of debugging integrations under time pressure.
recommended_actions: Rotate exposed credentials and replace live values with placeholders.
